defmodule Phase147HTTP do
  def request(:get, "https://repo.hex.pm/packages/mux" = url, headers, body, opts) do
    if Process.get(:mux_requests, 0) != 0, do: raise("second request refused")
    Process.put(:mux_requests, 1)
    IO.puts("MUX_REQUEST_STARTED")
    result = apply(:mix_hex_http_httpc, :request, [:get, url, headers, body, opts])
    case result do
      {:ok, {200, _, signed}} when byte_size(signed) <= 8_388_608 ->
        File.write!(Process.get(:object_path), signed, [:exclusive])
      _ -> :ok
    end
    result
  end
end
defmodule Phase147Route do
  def request(:get, url, _headers, _body, _opts) do
    Process.put(:observed_url, url)
    {:error, :offline_route_probe}
  end
end
[stage, preflight_path] = System.argv()
p = preflight_path |> File.read!() |> :json.decode()
t = p["tuple"]
otp = :erlang.system_info(:otp_release) |> to_string()
patch = Path.join([to_string(:code.root_dir()), "releases", otp, "OTP_VERSION"]) |> File.read!() |> String.trim()
unless System.version() == "1.17.3" and patch == "27.3.4.15", do: raise("unsupported runtime")
{:module, _} = Code.ensure_loaded(Hex.Registry.Server)
beam = :code.which(Hex.Registry.Server) |> to_string() |> Path.expand()
unless beam == Path.join(t["ebin"], "Elixir.Hex.Registry.Server.beam"), do: raise("foreign Hex BEAM")
:ok = Application.load(:hex)
{:ok, hex} = :application.get_key(:hex, :vsn)
unless to_string(hex) == "2.5.1", do: raise("wrong Hex version")
{:ok, _} = Application.ensure_all_started(:ssl)
{:ok, _} = Application.ensure_all_started(:inets)
config = apply(:mix_hex_core, :default_config, [])
unless config.repo_url == "https://repo.hex.pm" and config.repo_name == "hexpm" and
         config.repo_verify and config.repo_verify_origin, do: raise("unexpected Hex origin contract")
hash = fn data -> :crypto.hash(:sha256, data) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower) end
result = if stage == "route" do
  {:error, :offline_route_probe} = apply(:mix_hex_repo, :get_package, [%{config | http_adapter: {Phase147Route, %{}}}, "mux"])
  unless Process.get(:observed_url) == t["url"], do: raise("observed request route differs")
  %{stage: stage, url: Process.get(:observed_url), network_request_count: 0, elixir: System.version(),
    otp_patch: patch, hex: to_string(hex), public_key_sha256: hash.(config.repo_public_key)}
else
  if System.get_env("HEX_OFFLINE") != "1" or System.get_env("HEX_UNSAFE_REGISTRY") != "0" or
       System.get_env("HEX_NO_VERIFY_REPO_ORIGIN") != "0", do: raise("unsafe environment")
  signed = if stage == "request" do
    Process.put(:object_path, t["object"])
    tls = [verify: :verify_peer, cacerts: :public_key.cacerts_get(), depth: 3,
      customize_hostname_check: [match_fun: :public_key.pkix_verify_hostname_match_fun(:https)]]
    adapter = {Phase147HTTP, %{http_options: [ssl: tls, autoredirect: false, timeout: 15_000, connect_timeout: 10_000]}}
    {:ok, {200, _, _}} = apply(:mix_hex_repo, :get_package, [%{config | http_adapter: adapter}, "mux"])
    File.read!(t["object"])
  else
    File.read!(t["object"])
  end
  {:ok, record} = apply(:mix_hex_registry, :unpack_package, [signed, "hexpm", "mux", config.repo_public_key])
  unless record.repository == "hexpm" and record.name == "mux", do: raise("registry origin mismatch")
  [release] = Enum.filter(record.releases, &(&1.version == "3.2.2"))
  inner = Base.encode16(release.inner_checksum, case: :lower)
  outer = Base.encode16(release.outer_checksum, case: :lower)
  unless inner == p["lock"]["inner_sha256"] and outer == p["lock"]["outer_sha256"], do: raise("lock mismatch")
  before = File.read!(t["cache_destination"]) |> hash.()
  Mix.start()
  {:ok, _} = apply(Hex.State, :start_link, [[]])
  apply(Hex.State, :put, [:repos, %{"hexpm" => apply(Hex.Repo, :default_hexpm_repo, [])}])
  unless apply(Hex.State, :fetch!, [:offline]) and not apply(Hex.State, :fetch!, [:unsafe_registry]) and
           not apply(Hex.State, :fetch!, [:no_verify_repo_origin]), do: raise("Hex safety state differs")
  {:ok, _} = apply(Hex.Registry.Server, :start_link, [[]])
  :ok = apply(Hex.Registry.Server, :open, [[registry_path: t["cache_destination"], check_version: false]])
  if stage == "request" do
    send(Hex.Registry.Server, {:get_package, "hexpm", "mux", {:ok, {200, %{}, record}}})
    :ok = apply(Hex.Registry.Server, :persist, [])
  end
  :ok = apply(Hex.Registry.Server, :prefetch, [[{"hexpm", "mux"}]])
  cached_inner = apply(Hex.Registry.Server, :inner_checksum, ["hexpm", "mux", "3.2.2"]) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)
  cached_outer = apply(Hex.Registry.Server, :outer_checksum, ["hexpm", "mux", "3.2.2"]) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)
  unless cached_inner == inner and cached_outer == outer, do: raise("offline cache mismatch")
  after_hash = File.read!(t["cache_destination"]) |> hash.()
  if stage == "read" and before != after_hash, do: raise("offline read modified cache")
  %{stage: stage, url: t["url"], network_request_count: Process.get(:mux_requests, 0), elixir: System.version(),
    otp_patch: patch, hex: to_string(hex), os_pid: System.pid(), signature_verified: true, origin_verified: true,
    inner_sha256: inner, outer_sha256: outer, object_sha256: hash.(signed), public_key_sha256: hash.(config.repo_public_key),
    cache_before: before, cache_sha256: after_hash, offline: true, persisted: stage == "request", restarted: stage == "read"}
end
IO.puts("MUX_PROOF " <> (:json.encode(result) |> IO.iodata_to_binary()))
